item.title: Swapping a shift at your part-time job
item.context_text: You work part-time at a café in your university building. Next Thursday morning you have an exam, but you are on the rota that day. You need to find someone to swap with.
item.objective_text: Read the rota, find a colleague who can swap, and tell your manager.
item.target_grammar: can / could for requests (Could you work my shift?)
item.cultural_note: In many workplaces, you find a colleague to swap with first and then ask the manager. Asking early and giving a reason is seen as professional.
success_conditions: Read the rota and the swap rules
Ask a colleague to swap and explain why
Tell your manager about the change

children.title: Read the staff rota
children.instructions: Read next week's rota. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
STAFF ROTA — next week
Mon: Aziz, Lola (9–3)
Tue: You, Timur (12–6)
Wed: Lola, Timur (12–6)
Thu: You, Aziz (9–3)
Fri: Lola, You (12–6)
To swap a shift: first find a person to swap with, then tell the manager by Friday.

questions.prompt: Which days do you work next week?
questions.explanation: The rota has "You" on Tuesday, Thursday and Friday.

questions.prompt: What must you do first to swap a shift?
options: Find a person to swap with
questions.explanation: "First find a person to swap with, then tell the manager."

children.title: Listen to Lola
children.instructions: You asked Lola for help. She answers with a voice message. Listen and answer the questions. You can listen again.
children.prompt_text: Hi, it's Lola. I got your message about Thursday. Sorry, I can't help. I have a class on Thursday morning. But Timur is free that day. He wants a day off on Wednesday, so maybe you can swap with him. Good luck with your exam!

questions.explanation: "I have a class on Thursday morning."
"He wants a day off on Wednesday."

children.title: Write to Timur
children.instructions: Write to Timur. Ask him to work your Thursday shift, offer to work his Wednesday shift, and say why.
children.prompt_text: Timur: Hi! Lola says you want to talk to me?
children.goal: Ask Timur to swap shifts and explain why.
children.model_answer: Hi Timur! Yes, I have an exam next Thursday morning. Could you work my Thursday shift from 9 to 3? I can work your Wednesday shift from 12 to 6. Thank you!

children.title: Tell your manager
children.instructions: Timur says yes. Now tell your manager about the swap. Explain the change and the reason.
children.prompt_text: Manager: Hi, you wanted to see me?
children.goal: Explain the swap and the reason to your manager.
children.model_answer: Yes. I have an exam next Thursday, so Timur and I want to swap shifts. He can work on Thursday and I can work on Wednesday. Is that OK?
